stops.name: Parco regionale storico di Monte Sole
stops.detail: The historical Monte Sole regional park is a protected natural area that was established in 1989 and is located in the metropolitan city of Bologna. It extends on the territory between the rivers Reno and Setta, theater, during the Second World War, of the trembling massacre of Monte Sole carried out by the Nazi-fascist militias in 1944. The historical park of Monte Sole extends for almost the entire area involved in the massacre. The establishment of this protected area, as well as the protection and enhancement of the environmental heritage, aims to keep alive the interest and memory of this dark piece of Italian history, the events of the Partigiana Stella Rossa Brigade, through the spread of a culture of peace aimed above all to the young generations.
